notes.title: Dungeon Knight V2.1 Version Update
notes.content:
In the V2.1 version, adjustments were made to some levels to enhance the overall experience.
Changes include:
* Slightly reduced the bullet speed in levels 23 and 25.
* Adjusted the position of moving platforms upward in level 35.
* Decreased the speed of moving platforms in level 44.

On a side note, we are actively developing a new game called "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746830/_/] Doom Survivors [/url]" an action roguelite survival game. Currently, our Steam page is live at: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746830/_. 
If you find the game intriguing, consider adding it to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746830/_/] Steam wishlist [/url]! Your support means a lot to us. Thanks for reading, and may you have a delightful day!

notes.title: DungeonKnightV2.0 Version Update
notes.content:
In V2.0, we have modified the details of some levels to provide a better experience


Modified levels

20. 24, 35, 36, 38, 40, 44



Fixed a stuck wall bug

Added some guidance for game routes

Changed the collision position of the prop

Reduced the difficulty of some levels
